text:
maya: Hey, seeing flaky exception shapes from the async Python client when auth fails (401). sometimes we get HttpError with .status_code and .raw_body, other times an ApiError with only .message
maya: hard to debug in CI since malformed JSON payloads just turn into a generic ApiError and the raw response is gone
sam: do you have a tiny repro? is this from responses.create or completions?
maya: responses.create with async client, minimal snippet below:
```py
async with RedwoodClient(api_key=MY_KEY) as client:
    try:
        await client.responses.create(model="gpt-4-mini", input="hi")
    except Exception as e:
        print(type(e), getattr(e, 'status_code', None), getattr(e, 'raw_body', None))
```
maya: sometimes prints HttpError 401 b'Unauthorized', sometimes ApiError None None (and message "unexpected JSON")
alex: sounds like our error path tries to parse JSON into ValidationError and when parsing fails we rewrap but forget to stash raw bytes on the ApiError
sam: also saw an unclosed connector warning when the parser raised inside __aenter__ for the async client. session not closed in that branch
maya: leaking aiohttp connectors in tests is noisy, we should close on all paths
ale: proposed fixes: 1) ensure every raised http exception includes status_code (int) and raw_body (bytes) fields 2) add error_json if parse succeeded 3) update type stubs/docs to mention ApiError/HttpError types so typed callers can catch them
sam: also add an optional on_auth_failure hook on client init that can refresh tokens and optionally retry once for 401s; current retry middleware treats non-5xx as non-retryable which is too blunt for short-lived tokens
maya: +1. please make the default non-retry but provide the hook for token-refresh flows
ale: low-level change: make async context manager robust: always close the aiohttp.ClientSession even if response parsing raises during __aenter__
lee-bot: /link https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/issues/601 (auto: created issue for async-exc-auth-rawbody-typing) :robot_face:
sam: I'll open a PR with tests: simulate 401 bodies both JSON and malformed, assert exception.raw_body preserved and connector not leaked
maya: test I'll add to our CI matrix to catch regressions (async loop debug on)
ale: docs: add migration note that ApiError now exposes status_code/raw_body/error_json; backwards compatible but callers should prefer attributes for robustness
sam: small DX tweak: when REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 include a one-line suggestion in exception repr like "Tip: set REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 to print raw response body"
maya: that will save SO much time during troubleshooting :heart:
lee-bot: /assign @sam @alex (auto: assigned)
maya: thanks folks, appreciate the quick turnaround
